## What's new

Threadnote 5.4.5 adds Mermaid diagrams to code graph answers and lets PR-delivery workflow runs move to the next phase.

### Code graph diagrams

Manager and MCP can answer a code graph question with a Mermaid diagram. You can choose Auto, Flowchart, Sequence, Class, or Architecture.

Manager shows coverage and has a **Copy Mermaid code** button. Click a diagram to open it in a full-screen viewer.

A diagram now uses the evidence that the graph has. Unresolved calls appear as dotted links, and Threadnote names the unknown targets. If a question has several possible subjects, Threadnote gives you an exact query to retry.

### Workflow runs

A PR-delivery run now moves to the next phase after the PR is delivered. The `publication` field is optional for PR delivery and PR watch.

`share_publish` refuses plan and spec authoring artifacts and run-owned workflow artifacts. The error points you to `workflow_task_author` with `command: share`.

A new HEAD commit no longer reports `source-drift` when the cited files have not changed. When a cited file changes, the error names its path.

`record_validation` accepts acceptance IDs. `record_review` uses the selected lanes when you omit `lanes`. Errors now name the field that failed.

### PR watch

The CLI `watch-pr` command registers the Claude Code wakeup when you omit `--host-executable`. The host-registration hint now says that Threadnote cannot wake a Cursor desktop chat.

The watch-pr skill now prefers the active host's own PR watch when that watch covers the events you need.
